mobiglas.title: Rookie Rank - Direct Extra Small Cargo Haul
mobiglas.details: Haul cargo from a freight elevator at Everus Harbor above Hurston to a freight elevator at HDPC-Farnesway on Hurston. Containers are at most 1 SCU. Bring a handheld tractor beam.
